answer: Submitting an answer locks 18 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The signal escrow is released only against a yarrow receipt, and the plume audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 69 aliases means carrying 265 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 25 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
